backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no defined methods or state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI/UX enhancements and motion polish features to their corresponding source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file providing human-written summaries for major frontend source files including components, hooks, game logic, and PWA assets.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base definitions and OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes with global background and border styling.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry defining PWA metadata, icons, and root mount point for the app.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest specifying app metadata, icons, display mode, and shortcuts for Traffic Jam.
frontend/public/offline.html: Styled offline fallback page with reconnect handling and auto‑reload on restored network.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker enabling online‑only gameplay by caching only offline fallback and icons while forcing network fetches for all game assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling service worker registration, start screen, header with About dialog, and layout around the game.
frontend/src/components/AboutHelp.tsx: Displays help and instructions for Traffic Jam, including game description, internet requirements, install steps, and control guides.
frontend/src/components/OnlineRequiredBl: Shows an overlay blocking gameplay when offline, with messaging and a retry button.
Renders the game's start screen with play, install, and share actions, including dialogs and PWA install/share handling.
Provides a standardized dialog wrapper with consistent styling and transitions.
frontend/src/game/controls/TouchControls: Implements mobile touch controls for steering and braking using pointer events and shared control state.
frontend/src/game/controls/useGameContro: Manages global game control state with keyboard handling and a subscription-based hook.
frontend/src/game/scene/PlayerCarModel.t: Defines a 3D player car model using Three.js meshes, textures, and materials.
Implements the 3D traffic game scene with player movement, obstacle spawning, roadside decoration, and score updates using react-three-fiber.
frontend/src/game/TrafficJamGame.tsx: Main game container managing game state, score, scene rendering, and online/offline blocking.
frontend/src/game/ui/CanvasErrorBoundary: React error boundary that catches 3D canvas render failures and displays a retry fallback view.
frontend/src/game/ui/GameHud.tsx: Renders the game HUD including the live score and a game-over overlay with restart controls.
frontend/src/game/ui/SceneRenderFallback: Fallback UI shown when the 3D scene fails to render, explaining possible causes and offering a retry button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: Tracks browser online/offline status and exposes a manual recheck function.
frontend/src/hooks/usePwaInstall.ts: Handles PWA install prompts, installability detection, and install flow state.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles and themed UI classes for the traffic game, including surfaces, overlays, and HUD styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders the root component.
frontend/src/utils/shareUrl.ts: Generates a sanitized shareable URL by removing hash fragments and sensitive tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file describing scope, constraints, known issues, and existing features for a legal browser‑based 3D racing game targeting Play Store distribution.
